html:
G'oya

Ikki alohida savol: eng qimmat mahsulot qaysi va eng arzoni qaysi. Har birini ORDER BY ... LIMIT 1 bilan topib, ikki natijani UNION ALL bilan bitta jadvalga qo'yamiz.

Yechim

SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT 'eng qimmat' AS kind, id, name, price FROM products
  WHERE price IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY price DESC, id
  LIMIT 1
) a
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT 'eng arzon', id, name, price FROM products
  WHERE price IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY price, id
  LIMIT 1
) b

To'plam amalida ORDER BY va LIMIT faqat eng oxirida turishi mumkin va ular butun natijaga qo'llanadi. Har bir qismni o'z LIMITi bilan cheklash uchun qismlar hosila jadvalga o'raladi.

Tuzoqlar

ORDER BYni qismlarning birinchisiga yozsangiz, ikkala baza ham sintaksis xatosini beradi:

Noto'g'riSELECT 'eng qimmat' AS kind, id, name, price FROM products
ORDER BY price DESC, id LIMIT 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'eng arzon', id, name, price FROM products
ORDER BY price, id LIMIT 1

WHERE price IS NOT NULL shart. PostgreSQL kamayish tartibida NULLni boshiga qo'yadi, shuning uchun "eng qimmat" Globus bo'lib chiqadi. SQLite esa o'sish tartibida NULLni boshiga qo'yadi va u yerda Globus "eng arzon" bo'ladi. Har bir bazada bittadan qator buziladi.

WHERE price = (SELECT MAX(price) FROM products) bilan yozilsa, NULL muammosi yo'qoladi, lekin teng narxlar qoladi: namunada 95000 ikkita, 3000 ham ikkita, va har biri ikki qator beradi. MIN(id) bilan bittasini tanlash kerak.

Boshqa yo'l

ROW_NUMBER bilan har bir mahsulotga ikki tomondan o'rin beriladi, keyin birinchilari olinadi:

SELECT 'eng qimmat' AS kind, id, name, price
FROM (SELECT p.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY price DESC, id) AS rn FROM products p WHERE price IS NOT NULL) t
WHERE rn = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'eng arzon', id, name, price
FROM (SELECT p.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY price, id) AS rn FROM products p WHERE price IS NOT NULL) t
WHERE rn = 1
